caption: The drawing depicts a single large mug rendered primarily in pencil, shaded to give the effect of a metallic or reflective surface. The mug is shown with a prominent rounded body, slightly flared at the mouth, a pronounced curved handle on the right, and a small round base. The mug’s surface displays some engraved text and a small emblem or crest near the upper left area of its front. Above the mug, “MUG” is written in all capital letters. Surrounding the mug and filling the background are loose, brownish watercolor washes. In the lower left corner is a small outlined box labeled “SIDE ELEVATION” that contains a simple line drawing of the mug in profile view. In the lower right corner, handwritten text reads "Case 3 No. 131099-23 6 in. High" and "ALFRED NASON.” The drawing is on aged paper bordered by a simple double pencil line, with additional sepia-toned stains and irregular patches seen on the paper background.
title: Silver Mug
